basic_info.description: Experience refined urban living in Pacific Heights in this sophisticated one-bedroom + office condominium, in the highly sought-after Pacific Place. Designed for both comfort and style, the open living and dining area features wood flooring, a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite counters, a separate office nook, and a walk-out sunny patio. It is freshly painted, with custom window treatments and new carpet in the bedroom.  Wake up to southern views of the city framed by sound-resistant double-pane windows.  Enjoy modern conveniences, including an in-unit washer/dryer, deeded parking, and additional storage. Pacific Place, built in 2001, offers an array of upscale amenities: a pool, relaxing spa, gym, a beautifully landscaped courtyard, 24 hour security, and professional on-site management. With pet-friendly policies, deeded 1-car parking and bicycle parking, this home is designed to fit your lifestyle.  Located a block from the vibrant Polk Street corridor with numerous restaurants and shops, this residence boasts a Walk Score of 99a true walker's paradise Don't miss this rare opportunity to own in one of the city's premier buildings!
